items.title: 61529_Maxine Sullivan oral history interview
items.q: Aunt Jo gave me a little poem... I stayed with Aunt Jo... the families were very close.

ctx.x: Okay, and another five or so miles beyond that you come to Duquesne.
That's right, where Earl Hines was born, yeah. And the area there, McKeesport, East Liberty and all those little towns around there, mill towns.

And so, Aunt Jo gave me a little poem I guess, to recite in church and she said if I wasn't speaking loud enough she would give me a signal to speak louder and that's when I got up and started singing the 'Chinese Blues' and she waved and I thought that meant to sing louder and I did --
